name: FibreBuildProgressTracker
tagline: Run your FTTP rollout from one screen – homes passed, gates, snags and RFS slippage.
description: A complete fibre rollout app for Power Apps and Power Pages: dashboard with rollout funnel and contractor performance, rollout map, build-area grid with bulk actions, stage board with permit, civils, splicing and snag gates, RFS timeline with drag-to-reforecast, and a permits & snags workspace. Works instantly with demo data and binds to any table in a few clicks.
features: Configurable stage gates (permits %, civils %, critical snags, clear snag list)
Planned vs forecast RFS slippage and overdue flags
Premises → homes passed → connected funnel and take-up
Bulk contractor, priority, forecast and stage changes with undo
